name: Station DC feeder selectivity boundary
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Shows the protective-device relationship considered when assigning downstream DC fault isolation.
description: Shows the protective-device relationship considered when assigning downstream DC fault isolation. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “DC feeder protective devices” at the input and “Defined protection relationship” at the output. Selectivity requires a DC protection assessment.
